summary: Tested new site appearance/theme toggle feature end-to-end. Backend (GET /api/settings/appearance public, PUT /api/admin/settings/appearance admin-only) works correctly with proper auth guarding, persistence, and invalid-theme fallback. Frontend admin Settings > Website appearance card shows both buttons with correct data-testids; clicking Dark switches document.documentElement class off 'theme-light' and body bg to rgb(7,7,7); clicking Light re-adds 'theme-light' with bg rgb(251,250,247). Both states persist across full page reload of the public homepage. Final theme left as LIGHT per user requirement (verified via /api/settings/appearance -> {theme:'light'}).

issues: The gold script text 'Step inside.' on The CLA Studio hero card has very low contrast against the light photo overlay and is nearly illegible.
The 'SCROLL' indicator at bottom of hero is very faint on the light background.

action_items: Consider darkening or adding a subtle text shadow to the script 'Step inside.' text and the SCROLL indicator when in light theme for better contrast.
critical_code_review_comments: Appearance endpoints correctly validate theme value and default to 'dark' for invalid input.
MongoDB _id is properly excluded via projection in get_appearance.
Admin PUT is protected via require_admin dependency (returns 403 without token, verified).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Appearance toggle feature fully verified. DB currently set to theme=light. Only cosmetic contrast tweaks suggested for light theme hero overlay text.
